about.title: Whittier Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Grief does not follow a schedule, but California's wrongful death rules do. In Whittier, a city of roughly 87,000 people in Los Angeles County, public records show 7 traffic deaths in 2025 alongside 443 injury collisions. Those numbers are small on paper and enormous for the households behind them. Many of the city's reported crashes cluster along Whittier Boulevard, Lambert Road, Beverly Boulevard and Painter Avenue, often on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m., when people are simply heading home. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, entirely separate from anything a prosecutor may or may not pursue. It exists so that a spouse, domestic partner, children or other eligible heirs can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that listens to what happened and connects you with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Whittier Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Respect for the two-year clock
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must begin within two years of the date of death, and claims involving a city, county or other government entity carry much shorter notice deadlines. Connecting early keeps those options open.

items.title: Full accounting of what was lost
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial expenses to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. The attorney you are matched with works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative died in a crash on Whittier Boulevard and the driver may face charges. Do we wait for the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and runs on its own track, separate from any criminal proceeding in Los Angeles County. Waiting for a criminal outcome can eat into the two-year filing window, so it is wise to speak with an attorney early. Evidence from the police investigation may still be useful to your civil case.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law places a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first in line. If there are none, certain dependents or heirs who would inherit under California law may qualify. Because eligibility can be complicated in blended or extended families, an independent attorney can confirm who should be named before the claim is filed.

items.question: How long do we have to act if a government vehicle or public road condition was involved?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California require a formal administrative claim on a far shorter timeline than the standard two years, often measured in months. Missing that step can end the case before it starts. If a city, county or state agency may share responsibility, contact us as soon as you are able so an attorney can review the deadline that applies.
